mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.8% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.8%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) rise above 4.0% after a 3-month increase from below 4.0% signals economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 2% in one month indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: When RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 2% in 1 month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO > 105) with low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) defines a late-cycle expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, increasing corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 5.0% year-over-year indicates persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening that causes negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% (y/y).

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1.5% in one month signal manufacturing and construction slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline > 1.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: When INDPRO and HOUST both decline > 1.5% in 1 month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS above 4.0% with CPIAUCSL exceeding 5.0% defines a monetary tightening cycle, causing equity volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 5.0%.
